goal: Dual independent per-source chains (Guardian, MIT) sharing one static store. A dead source kills only its own chain; the sibling stores and reports normally. No activation.

processing.action: Per-chain rssFeedRead with fixed URL + onError continue
Route error items to per-chain Quarantine
Merge into shared static store by fingerprint

conditions: Error items go to per-chain Quarantine, good items continue
externalServices: Public RSS GET requests (Guardian, MIT TR)

outputs.description: Per-chain report: workflow, chain, chainStatus, sourcesTotal, chainNew, storedTotal, aiMode, runAt
outputs.storage: Static store newsDates (local SQLite, merged by fingerprint)

deduplication.strategy: in-batch + cross-chain merge by fingerprint in shared store

storage: Static store (SQLite, per-workflow). No files. No wipe of existing data.

dataSentExternally: public RSS GET requests only (feed XML download)
